experiment_data.hypothesis: Step_independent generation (h=2) with episode-level advantage eliminates sign misattribution while preserving truncated-context inference. If success >> h=2 step-level (0%), information loss alone does not cause collapse — sign misattribution is the primary driver. If success ≈ 0%, information loss is sufficient to cause collapse regardless of advantage computation. This is the key factorial experiment separating the two mechanisms.

experiment_data.notes: W&B 深度分析确认：sign misattribution 是 collapse 的 primary driver。关键证据：step 3→4 hsweep action_valid 91.3%→43.1% (catastrophic collapse) vs factorial 保�� 79-85% (无崩溃)。V-shaped recovery (20.3%→3.1%→15.63%) 是探索期波动非不可逆退化。3-cell 贡献：sign misattribution ~6pp (0%→5.97% val), information loss ~22pp (5.97%→28.1% val)。Sign misattribution pp 贡献较小但是 catastrophic collapse 的质变 trigger。
